resources.string: Halo Scan analyses samples on a computer running the Halo Scan server. Connect this phone to the same Wi-Fi as that computer, then enter the address shown when the server starts.
Can\'t reach a Halo Scan server at that address. Check that the computer is on, the server is running, and this phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
Can\'t reach the Halo Scan server
Check that the computer is on, the server is running, and this phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the computer.
Camera permission is needed to take sample photos.
No camera app found on this phone.
